scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Run the first T03 controlled sensitivity as a three-point channel-length-only scan around the frozen 10 um T02-C reference, while reporting rather than assuming ideal inverse-length scaling.
fixed_variables: top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
interface_4x y mesh and fixed 0.25 um x spacing
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
top gate is primary and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
no traps, recombination, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: simultaneous trap, contact, dielectric, temperature, or mobility scans
experimental fitting or calibrated channel-length prediction
physical Ion, short-channel-effect, mobility, or uncertainty claims
compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

sensitivity.interpretation: Numerical local sensitivity over 8-12 um only; not a fitted process distribution or a short-channel validation.

remediation.reason: V1 correctly rejected the unvalidated assumption that this full 2D teaching model must reproduce ideal 1/L current and gm scaling with <=2 percent product spread and <=2 mV VTH variation. V2 preserves that failed hypothesis as a reported diagnostic and makes reproducible controlled sensitivity, convergence, conservation, extraction validity, directional response, and T02-C reproduction the completion gate.
unchanged_simulation_inputs: materials, mobility, contacts, equations, and temperature
mesh spacing and enabled dual-gate topology
bias initialization, sweep grid, and representative states
VTH, gm, on-current, and length-scaling extraction formulas
resource budget and persisted output fields
remediation.prohibited_interpretation: The V2 completion gate does not convert the failed V1 ideal-scaling hypothesis into a pass and does not validate a physical scaling law.

inheritance.reference_family: top_primary at fixed secondary gate = 0 V

execution_order: create one fresh enabled dual-gate device for each channel length
solve all-zero-bias Poisson initialization and coupled electron equilibrium
repeat the T02-C low-VDS ladder with both gates at 0 V
precondition the top primary gate from 0 V down to -0.5 V
sweep the exact 31-point top-gate grid upward with bottom gate fixed at 0 V
save the VTOP=1.0 V state for each length
delete the device before creating the next length

constant_current_vth_proxy.name: constant_current_log_interpolation
constant_current_vth_proxy.interpolation: linear primary-gate-voltage interpolation in log10(abs(drain current per unit width))

gm_proxy.name: central_difference_then_linear_interpolation
gm_proxy.definition: central-difference derivative of abs(drain current per unit width) versus primary-gate voltage, linearly interpolated at VTH + 0.2 V

on_state_current_proxy.label: sampled low-VDS on-state current proxy; not physical Ion

length_scaling.log_slope: ordinary least squares slope of log(abs current at VTOP=1 V) versus log(L_cm)
length_scaling.role: reported sensitivity diagnostics; ideal inverse-length agreement is not a V2 completion gate

ideal_inverse_length.interpretation: PASS would only indicate agreement with an idealized internal scaling diagnostic; FAIL is a valid sensitivity result and remains explicitly reported.

state_output_contract.bias: VDS=0.01 V, VBG=0 V, VTG=1.0 V

electron_current_density.source_model: DEVSIM ElectronCurrent edge model projected by element_from_edge_model

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: T03-P4-L may establish a reproducible three-point local channel-length sensitivity only for the frozen E2 teaching model when the V2 contract, numerical-quality and directional-response run checks, T02-C reference reproduction, states, and independent checks pass; the failed ideal 1/L diagnostic remains a reported limitation.
prohibited_claims: experimentally calibrated channel-length dependence or process distribution
physical Ion, short-channel-effect validation, scaling-law proof, or parameter uncertainty
geometry/dielectric group variables other than the configured channel length
trap, contact, temperature, mobility, ferroelectric, compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only contract PASS permits the T03-P4-L run; only simulation plus independent persisted-evidence PASS completes this one channel-length sensitivity group.
